## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scientific impact

- [ ] No solver semantics, Hamiltonian, common-MCS mapping, or output definitions changed.
- [ ] Scientific behavior changed intentionally and is documented below.

If scientific behavior changed, describe the old/new definitions and the rationale.

## Validation

- [ ] `cmake --build ...` succeeds.
- [ ] `ctest --test-dir ... --output-on-failure` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has a regression/correspondence test where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated if the public interface changed.
